title: Gravitomotive Transmission
definition: A theoretical model that demonstrates how a black hole functions as a self-sustaining, non-linear geometric structure of spacetime that transmits angular momentum.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a black hole as a machine that uses the power of space and time to transfer energy. This concept helps us understand how black holes work.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: This concept is a theoretical model that explains how a black hole acts as a self-sustaining, non-linear structure in spacetime, transmitting angular momentum through a phenomenon known as frame-dragging.
difficulty_levels.expert: This concept is a novel application of general relativity that provides a deeper understanding of black holes. It challenges the traditional view of black holes as simple vacuum solutions and suggests they are more complex, dynamic systems. It also has implications for quantum gravity and the nature of space and time.

extra_fields.insight: The conversation highlighted the potential of using a more dynamic, geometric approach to understanding black holes.
